properties.name: Key Route Pier
properties.geometry_method: Traced by eye from USGS San Francisco 1:62,500 (1915) (2 hand-read points, centred on the line symbol and fitted straight (RMS 3 m)); then traced by eye from USGS San Francisco 1:62,500 (1915) (4 hand-read points, centred on the line symbol); the sheet corrected by a shift on 3 control points (Yerba Buena Island on the 1949 Oakland West sheet; +74 m E, +213 m N, RMS 44.8 m). The trestle runs straight from the shore, then curves to the ferry terminal.

sources.note: The sheet labels it "San Francisco–Oakland Terminal, Key Route Pier".
